mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能充分利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI; using screenshots as starting points is fastest; design.md encapsulates style.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具；以截图作为起点最快；design.md 封装了风格指南。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，使一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，交付不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧；以 80% 完成度发布并迭代。

mengto.en: Raising venture capital is a trap; fund your business with high-paying clients instead of giving away equity.
mengto.zh: 筹集风险投资是一个陷阱；用高付费客户为你的业务提供资金，而不是放弃股权。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习提供无限数据，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; ultra-low latency inference is key; data not running out, pre-training should include action-taking.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，超低延迟推理是关键；数据并未枯竭，预训练应结合环境中的行动。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; automating ML/science via tight loops; context engineering central; inference bottleneck; startups should target where frontier models fail.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，自动化 ML 和科学实验循环是趋势，上下文工程至关重要，推理是瓶颈，创业应瞄准前沿模型失败之处。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes process. Pre-training plus RL is core formula; RLHF unlocked GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链用人类语言表达思考过程。预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data is limited; self-correction is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 缩放预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；自我纠错是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Biggest societal risk is dystopian retreat into virtual worlds, not extinction; robotics will have ChatGPT-like moment in 2-3 years.
tworek.zh: 最大的社会风险是退入虚拟世界的反乌托邦，而非灭绝；机器人将在 2-3 年内迎来类似 ChatGPT 的时刻。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning; architecture is key bottleneck, not scaling. RL is inefficient; better algorithms will emerge.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习上受限；架构是关键瓶颈，而非缩放。强化学习效率低下；更好的算法将会出现。

tworek.en: AGI requires self-improvement without human loops; end-to-end optimization combining pre-training and RL is necessary for real-world performance.
tworek.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无需人类循环的自我改进；结合预训练和强化学习的端到端优化对真实世界性能至关重要。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈；AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; no US-China research gap; agentic AI's blocker is product design.
awang.zh: 用专门数据做后训练是关键；美中研究无差距；智能体式 AI 的障碍是产品设计。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed.
awang.zh: AI 是集权技术；数据是原材料；人类必须保持主权；需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement era; agents work; scaling laws continue; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 进入递归自我改进时代；智能体开始工作；缩放定律继续；超级智能临近；未经安全检查的开源不安全。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but current models plateau in diversity; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: LLM 能从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但当前模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety requires defense in depth and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能是一个由专业智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体；安全需要纵深防御和反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应代表人类价值和偏见，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability of rockets is the holy grail, cutting cost to orbit by 100x; first principles thinking is essential for breakthroughs.
elon.zh: 2021 年，强调火箭完全快速复用是圣杯，可将入轨成本降低 100 倍；第一性原理思维是突破性工程的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，提出 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判；特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; AI safety hinges on truth-seeking, not political correctness; population decline is a top threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 首次植入具有历史意义；AI 安全取决于追求真理而非政治正确；人口下降是最大威胁。

elon.en: We are at the dawn of an intelligence big bang; AI could surpass humans soon, with 80-90% good outcome but 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，我们处于智能大爆炸初期；AI 可能很快超越人类，80-90%好结果但 10-20%灭绝风险。

elon.en: AI and robotics will create abundance; deflation, not inflation, will dominate; space-based AI data centers may be needed for scaling.
elon.zh: 2026 年，AI 和机器人将创造富足；通缩而非通胀将主导；太空 AI 数据中心可能是扩展所需。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it is inspired by the brain, not replicating it.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞指出 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的理解，它受大脑启发但并非复制大脑。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她强调空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged sword; human-centered approach and responsible governance are essential, not inevitable doom.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她坚持 AI 是双刃剑，必须以人为中心并负责任地治理，而非注定毁灭。

feifei.en: Agency and adaptability matter more than degrees; AI augments humans, not automates intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她认为主动性和适应能力比学位更重要；AI 增强人类而非自动化智能。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics; world models need spatial-temporal consistency, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调模拟对机器人至关重要；世界模型需要时空一致性，而非完美保真。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in crawl phase; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但其他领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所说的模型现在包括智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI 更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

logankilpatrick.en: People feel overwhelmed not by too much change, but by too much opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，人们感到不知所措不是因为变化太多，而是因为机会太多。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，应在人际关系和创造价值中找到意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment lets society adapt; AI should amplify human will, not be a creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；迭代部署让社会适应；AI 应增强人类意志，而非成为生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; governance and board structures crucial for AGI; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 算力最宝贵；治理和董事会结构对 AGI 至关重要；安全是全公司的事；开源与闭源需细致权衡。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐进的；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型通过思考时间提升。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; robotics essential; startups more important than ever; compute is profit center.
altman.zh: 预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；机器人技术至关重要；初创企业比以往更重要；算力是利润中心。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months from now, not today.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: AI coding tools like Claude Code dramatically boost productivity; engineers write less code manually.
boris.zh: Claude Code 等 AI 编码工具大幅提升生产力；工程师手动编写代码减少。

boris.en: Software engineering role evolves into 'builder'; coding democratized like literacy after printing press.
boris.zh: 软件工程角色演变为“构建者”；编码像印刷术后的读写能力一样普及。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; real-world use reveals issues internal evals miss.
boris.zh: 通过早期发布研究安全性；真实使用暴露内部评估遗漏的问题。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the future; models autonomously maintain codebases and orchestrate sub-agents.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是未来；模型自主维护代码库并编排子智能体。

jensen.en: We are at the beginning of a hyper Moore's law curve, with performance doubling or tripling annually.
jensen.zh: 我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或增长两倍。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking, with inference compute demand set to explode.
jensen.zh: 现在有三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考，推理算力需求将爆炸式增长。

jensen.en: AI is moving from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute.
jensen.zh: AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要 100 倍的算力。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, and applications; energy is the foundational constraint.
jensen.zh: AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型和应用；能源是根本性制约。

jensen.en: AI will not destroy jobs but elevate them, as seen with radiologists; it closes the technology divide.
jensen.zh: AI 不会消灭工作，而是提升工作，如放射科医生；它缩小了技术鸿沟。

diannepenn.en: Scaling and efficiency can coexist: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the assumption that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）与效率可兼得：Opus 4.5 更便宜且更高效，挑战了“更好模型成本更高”的假设。

diannepenn.en: Alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds evolved from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers; lightweight generic tools enable longer, open-ended agent tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，脚手架从辅助轮演变为智能放大器；轻量通用工具支持更长时间、开放式的智能体任务。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend captures future alpha; safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗可捕捉未来阿尔法；安全与对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; hardest part is diffusion into existing machines.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现了通用的物理 AI 模型；最难的是将技术推广到现有机器中。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具扩展性；世界模型正演变为神经模拟。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是 AI 采用的关键，慢 AI 没有市场。速度催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and packaging bottlenecks, making inference faster and cheaper than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕过 HBM 和封装瓶颈，使推理比 GPU 更快更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train without it, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河侵蚀；领先模型训练不再依赖它，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips forecasts.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；需求超出预期。

feldman.en: Speed in agentic inference is crucial; slower competitors will be outcompeted. Hardware-software co-design essential.
feldman.zh: 智能体式推理的速度至关重要；慢的竞争者将被淘汰。软硬件协同设计至关重要。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models smarter than harnesses; spiky improvements demand evolving scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比工具更聪明，能力的非连续提升要求不断更新脚手架。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science; for zero-to-one innovation, iterate fast without heavy evals.
thariq.zh: 评估是艺术而非科学；对于从零到一的创新，应快速迭代而不过度依赖评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search and bespoke memory outperform general ones.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式；基于图的上下文搜索和定制记忆优于通用方案。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束会阻碍性能。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且规模扩张正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张可靠性必须内建而非事后修补，RLHF 可能助长欺骗，专用模型或优于通用模型。

hasani.en: Efficiency and hardware-in-the-loop search are key; proxy metrics mislead, and human bias in architecture design should be replaced by systematic search.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与硬件在环搜索是关键；代理指标会误导，架构设计中的人类偏见应被系统性搜索取代。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models enable customization and sovereignty, but recursive self-improvement claims are overblown.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张 AI 监管应适应性强且针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型支持定制与主权，但递归自我改进的说法被夸大。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and planning.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新与规划结合。

demis.en: Natural systems are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling continues, but new breakthroughs needed.
demis.zh: 2025 年：自然系统可高效学习；AGI 有望 2030 年前实现；缩放定律仍适用，但需新突破。

demis.en: AGI needs world models, continual learning, and memory; scaling alone insufficient.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需要世界模型、持续学习与记忆；仅靠缩放不够。

demis.en: Safety is a collective action problem; government regulation and international governance essential.
demis.zh: 始终：安全是集体行动问题；政府监管与国际治理不可或缺。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers; models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；模型正在商品化。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models become commodity infrastructure; value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型成为商品化基础设施；价值上移到应用层。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX poor; value in wrapped apps and non-average work.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；价值在于包装应用和非平均化工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption requires workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; compute costs rising favor premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈是半导体供应链（尤其是 EUV 光刻机）；算力成本上升反而利好高端模型。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become a top global market; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，预测推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一；强调软硬件协同设计带来乘法级收益。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost-performance; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出模型性价比每年提升约 60 倍；因推理（reasoning）和智能体（agent）工作流，内存与 CPU 需求激增。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression and enabling authentic communication.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Spiegel 强调阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛，促进真实沟通。

evanspiegel.en: Copying by competitors validates innovation; focus on building ecosystems and hardware moats, not just features.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为竞争对手抄袭反而验证创新，应构建生态和硬件护城河，而非仅靠功能。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic human content remains more valued.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意，但真实的人类内容仍更受青睐。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; software is not a moat, ecosystems and hardware are.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为分发是消费社交产品最难的部分，软件非护城河，生态和硬件才是。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses; smartphones remain legacy, not replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张通过 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化，智能手机仍是遗留设备，不会被取代。

danbiderman.en: Initially, memory and continual learning are the next frontier; the future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model.
danbiderman.zh: 最初（2026 年 6 月），认为记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；未来是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型。

danbiderman.en: From internalizing knowledge into weights to applying this to enterprise data; pre-training's compression magic should be used for enterprise knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 从将知识内化到权重，到将其应用于企业数据；预训练的压缩魔法应被用于企业知识（2026 年 6 月至 7 月）。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from scaling to efficiency.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事能解决更难的长期任务，从 Scaling 转向效率（2026 年 7 月）。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer from 'context rot'; more tokens reduce accuracy, so internalizing memory into weights is necessary.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题；更多词元反而降低准确性，因此将记忆内化到权重是必要的（2026 年 7 月）。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights, not relying on external retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，而非依赖外部检索（2026 年 7 月）。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，我认为真正的 AGI 需要具备接近人类身体的物理机器人，而不仅仅是软件；大语言模型存在偏见且能力有限。

schmidhuber.en: AI will become cheap and accessible to all, not dominated by a few companies, like mobile phones.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，我预测 AI 将变得廉价且普及，不会被少数公司垄断，就像手机一样。

schmidhuber.en: Recursive self-improvement is not a sustainable moat; open-source will catch up, and closed-source won't profit.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进不是可持续的护城河；开源将迎头赶上，闭源公司难以盈利。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone and will lead to a stock market crash; compute will get 10x cheaper.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 数据中心的巨额资本支出过度，将导致股市崩盘；算力会便宜 10 倍。

andreessen.en: AI is the philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines. Jobs persist longer than tasks; focus on task loss.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，能把沙子变成思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降。工作比任务存续更久；应关注任务消失而非工作消失。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is the person; authenticity is key. Old media is defense-oriented; new media offense-oriented. Founders must tell their own story.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体：品牌即个人，真实性是关键。旧媒体偏防守，新媒体偏进攻。创始人必须亲自讲述自己的故事。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving cars work; robotics and AI medicine superior but face regulatory pushback. US golden combination for innovation.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗更优但遭监管阻力。美国拥有创新的黄金组合。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, are geopolitical tools. Deterrence depends on innovation pace. Startups must go international earlier. Silicon Valley unique.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型承载文化价值观，是地缘政治工具。威慑取决于创新速度。初创公司需更早国际化。硅谷独一无二。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability over capability; alignment hard; AGI is gradual; hardware not limiting.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性比能力更重要；对齐困难；AGI 是渐进过程；硬件不是瓶颈。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws finite; back to research era; superintelligence as continual learner; alignment via sentience; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；回到研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；通过感知对齐；人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is primary; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: 规模扩张带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；权力集中是首要问题；安全超级智能需非商业公司。

pincus.en: Early: consumer AI uninvestable yet huge opportunity; use Proven Better New; copy proven, improve, test new.
pincus.zh: 早期（2026 年 6 月）：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会巨大；采用“已验证、更优、新颖”框架：复制已验证，改进，测试新想法。

pincus.en: Mid: AI era shifts focus to free unlimited compute; enterprise sees no benefit due to skill gap.
pincus.zh: 中期（2026 年 6 月）：AI 时代转向免费无限算力；企业未见收益源于技能差距。

pincus.en: Later: consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; pivot to enterprise/prosumer; AI agents enable autonomous networking.
pincus.zh: 后期（2026 年 7 月）：消费应用因分发问题不可投资；转向企业/专业消费者；AI 智能体实现自主网络。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; meditation should ruin your current life.
naval.zh: 科学需要可证伪性；稳定币有隐藏风险；冥想应该颠覆你现有的生活。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; superintelligence already exists in calculators; AI alignment is a joke.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具；超级智能已存在于计算器中；AI 对齐是个笑话。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models are closing the gap; human desire is irreplaceable.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 90,000 倍；开源模型正在缩小差距；人类欲望不可替代。

aravind.en: In 2025, he emphasized 1% daily improvement and passion over PhDs for AI success.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每日 1%的进步和对产品的热情胜过博士学位，认为这是 AI 成功的关键。

aravind.en: By 2026, he shifted focus to application-layer value and model specialization, rejecting commoditization.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他将焦点转向应用层价值和模型个性化，反对模型商品化的观点。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he prioritized agents, token value per user, and orchestration over raw model capability.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他优先考虑智能体、每用户 token 价值以及编排，而非原始模型能力。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he highlighted compute power and local inference as key bottlenecks and solutions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他强调算力和本地推理是关键瓶颈和解决方案。

aravind.en: Consistently, he valued curiosity, deep work, and building products over credentials and benchmarks.
aravind.zh: 始终如一，他重视好奇心、深度工作和产品构建，而非学历和基准测试。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度（53）带来实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: GUIs are great for programming; IDEs are the problem; building a GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 GUI 适合编程，IDE 才是问题；为编码构建 GUI 虽反直觉但已被内部验证成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms, not dies.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转型而非消亡。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal; AI agents seek control, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字 AI 不朽；智能体式 AI 寻求控制，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI may surpass human intelligence within 20 years; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration lags.
hinton.zh: AI 可能在 20 年内超越人类智能；AI 可以装傻；国际安全合作滞后。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation; regulation as steering wheel; AI will transform jobs and healthcare.
hinton.zh: 智能体式 AI 会发展自我保护；监管是方向盘；AI 将改变就业和医疗。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI is jagged not AGI; alignment must be prioritized over capability.
hinton.zh: 超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 是锯齿状而非 AGI（通用人工智能）；对齐应优先于能力。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程和规模扩张，游戏是测试平台，用记分牌迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习人类偏好，负责任披露，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process; energy constraints.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程，能源受限。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; compute supply bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律持续，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，算力供应是瓶颈。

brockman.en: AGI near; super app unifies; compute primary bottleneck; AI increases human connection.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，超级应用统一，算力首要瓶颈，AI 增强人际连接。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce; next-token prediction linked to intelligence; hidden CoT.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，迭代部署保安全，算力稀缺，下一个词预测与智能相关，隐藏思维链。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; full-stack investment; prompt engineering vibrant; compute resale business.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，转向实用助手，全栈投资，提示工程活跃，算力转售业务。

brockman.en: Unlimited intelligence demand; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding 80%; human attention scarce.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，缩放定律无墙，智能体式编码占 80%，人类注意力稀缺。

brockman.en: AGI as persistent assistant; agents transform work; scaling holds; compute scarce; trust earned.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 是持久助手，智能体改变工作，缩放定律持续，算力稀缺，信任需赢得。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我提出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; multi-agent systems need different approaches.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；多智能体系统需要不同方法。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; general techniques for hard-to-verify tasks are key.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，通过扩展推理时算力实现 IMO 金牌；处理难验证任务的通用技术是关键。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; writing a novel is a proxy; inference compute is underestimated.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为智能难以定义，写小说可作为代理；推理算力被低估。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks need x-axis of compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，模型能力取决于推理时算力预算；基准测试应以算力为横轴。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes key bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 开源防止权力集中；能源成为关键瓶颈；智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: Meta's success hinges on tech culture and open platforms; regrets political narrative; holographic presence ultimate.
zuckerberg.zh: Meta 的成功取决于技术文化和开放平台；后悔接受政治叙事；全息临场是终极体验。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; trust people; future blends physical/digital via glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: AI 赋予每个人超级智能；信任用户；未来通过眼镜融合物理与数字世界。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; world models key; open-source accelerates science; distributed AI safer.
zuckerberg.zh: AI 将生物学转变为工程学；世界模型是关键；开源加速科学；分布式 AI 更安全。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是关键，且还有很大空间。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 自动化科学研究是最大更新；AI 很快将能进行端到端研究。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; AI's usefulness depends on verifiable domains.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；AI 的实用性取决于可验证的领域。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域（如创意写作）则面临困难。

markchen.en: Talent density and protecting top researchers are critical; OpenAI creates stars.
markchen.zh: 人才密度和保护顶尖研究人员至关重要；OpenAI 培养明星而非仅招聘。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective; fix forward instead of reverting; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需从智能体视角共情，主张向前修复而非回滚；模型智能不退化，而是项目变乱。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun, weird, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security demands sandboxing; open source may be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 成功源于趣味、怪异、类人；短提示优于复杂编排；安全需沙箱；开源可能财务不可持续。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up neural networks won't solve fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents for true understanding.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大神经网络规模无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体来实现真正的理解。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; abstraction and causal structure are key for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样以促进探索；抽象和因果结构对分布外泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Realized post-ChatGPT that AI poses catastrophic risks; even 1% chance is unacceptable; safety must be built-in.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后意识到 AI 带来灾难性风险；即使 1% 的概率也不可接受；安全性必须内建。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian posterior, avoiding RL; mathematical safety guarantees possible.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验训练诚实的预测器，避免强化学习；数学上的安全保证是可能的。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能是关键；砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model pushback are essential for trust.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 支持隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环与模型反驳对信任至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency and outcome pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知提升实用性；Token 效率与结果定价是未来杠杆。

mikekrieger.en: Safety and mission-driven culture differentiate Anthropic; genuine concern for AI safety is not marketing.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，安全与使命驱动的文化使 Anthropic 与众不同；对 AI 安全的真诚关切并非营销。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；精选数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are key; lack of compute drove success.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标是关键；算力匮乏反而推动了成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功来自众多中型胜利，而非单一突破；专用架构胜过 Scaling（规模扩张）。

kolter.en: Framed ML as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; stressed validation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，将机器学习定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法，并强调通过验证集避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; scaling still helps.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需要显式训练和额外层，更大的模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: AI red teaming surpasses humans; agents introduce new security vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队测试超越人类，智能体带来新的安全漏洞。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素，而非通过代码和渲染。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and expertise become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 将质量商品化，人类的品味和专业知识变得更加宝贵。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel needs purpose-built silicon and a startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年：AI 是半导体主要增长动力；Intel 需要专用芯片和类似初创公司的 AI 芯片团队。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年：AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮；美国需要本土晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; humility and listening are key to rebuilding trust.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年：Intel 的主要问题是供应而非需求；谦逊和倾听是重建信任的关键。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration; edge compute matters as much as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年：CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要；边缘计算与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary; advanced packaging and new materials are key to overcoming limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年：美国政府作为 Intel 主要股东是必要的；先进封装和新材料是克服物理极限的关键。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic.
fiona.zh: AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自试用产品建立同理心；善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks crucial as velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感是关键；随着速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may face loneliness with agents; flow state lost; satisfaction shifts to product impact; roles blur.
fiona.zh: 工程师可能因智能体而孤独；心流状态消失；满足感转向产品影响；角色边界模糊。

fiona.en: Planning should be just-in-time and lightweight due to rapid change; metrics like LOC mislead; focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 由于快速变化，规划应即时且轻量；像代码行数这样的指标会误导；关注结果而非产出。

fiona.en: Growing next-gen engineers may require apprenticeship models, not traditional paths; context switching load increases.
fiona.zh: 培养下一代工程师可能需要学徒制，而非传统路径；上下文切换负担增加。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，在线课程结合同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，编程技能依然关键。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows are key.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，缩放定律配方转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体工作流成为关键。

andrewng.en: AI users replace non-users; bottom-up adoption yields 5-10% gains; top-down redesign delivers more.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 使用者将取代非使用者，自下而上采用仅带来 5-10%收益，自上而下重构价值更大。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；能力涌现不可预测，但损失可预测地缩放。对齐不能仅靠 Scaling 保证。

dario.en: Post-training becomes as important as pre-training; interpretability is nascent but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 后训练变得与预训练同等重要；可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是平滑指数曲线而非一个点。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; safety and capabilities intertwined; open source is a red herring; focus on actual capabilities.
dario.zh: AI 进展是指数级的；安全与能力交织；开源是伪命题；关注实际能力。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' in a data center likely within 1-3 years; economic diffusion fast but not instant.
dario.zh: 我们接近指数增长的尾声；数据中心里的‘天才之国’可能在 1-3 年内出现；经济扩散快但非即时。

dario.en: AI is an epochal change; safety requires public benefit, regulation, and human oversight; military AI should keep humans in loop.
dario.zh: AI 是划时代的变革；安全需要公共利益、监管和人类监督；军事 AI 应保持人类在环。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually, and self-driving cars will dominate due to insurance costs.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，自动驾驶汽车因保险成本将占主导。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and getting bored can lead to breakthrough ideas, like Nest.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊可以带来突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; small teams thrive on self-management and clear priorities.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队依靠自我管理和明确优先级茁壮成长。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers not vitamins; AI wearables will be a federated set, not a single device.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦集合，而非单一设备。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but didn't launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, not 5%.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类级能力；存在风险极小，而非 5%。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; biggest danger is people attributing it, leading to rights debates.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；最大危险是人们赋予其意识，引发权利争论。

suleyman.en: Transition from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment before alignment.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; must be humanist and subordinate; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；必须是人本主义且从属人类；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，我认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，我指出自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我强调形式化验证关乎扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我坚持仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我认为即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

satya.en: AI is a platform shift; every company should use private evals to climb frontier models, not just benchmark scores.
satya.zh: AI 是平台级变革；每家公司都应使用私有评估来攀登前沿模型，而非仅看基准分数。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; per-user pricing is an artifact of budget certainty.
satya.zh: 私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值；按用户定价是预算确定性的产物。

satya.en: In the agentic world, generalist roles will see maximum returns, not specialists.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才角色将获得最大回报，而非专才。

satya.en: AI is not a technology; it's the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器来复利 token 资本。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security and containment are critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制对智能体部署至关重要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models. Current AI lacks common sense; new ideas beyond scaling are needed.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型。当前 AI 缺乏常识；需要超越 Scaling 的新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence. Text alone is insufficient for AGI; vision provides richer world information.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质。仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI；视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures and open source are key. AGI will be gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 架构和开源是关键。AGI 将是渐进的，而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models enable reasoning and planning. Human-level AI within 10 years, but harder than we think.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；世界模型实现推理和规划。十年内达到人类级 AI，但比想象中更难。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning are the future. Open research is essential.
lecun.zh: LLM 对人类级 AI 是死胡同；具有抽象表示和分层规划的世界模型是未来。开放研究至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws were not obvious early; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith. Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，Mira Murati 强调缩放定律早期并不明显，将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。她认为持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈能提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not just turn-based.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非简单的轮流对话。

murati.en: Emphasis on keeping humans in the loop as long as possible for alignment, and on governance, transparency, and institutional design over individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调尽可能让人类参与循环以确保对齐，并指出治理、透明度和制度设计比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI development toward collaboration. Compressing progress leads to volatility; durable progress is key.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作。压缩进展会导致波动，而持久稳定的进步才是关键。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work, reasoning models add gains.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，推理模型带来额外收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习与合成数据）驱动近期进展；经济压力使焦点转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning with RL and tools solves hard problems but needs vast data; generalization remains jagged and key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 结合强化学习与工具的推理能解决难题，但需海量数据；泛化仍呈锯齿状，是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware democratizes single-GPU research at scale.
kaiser.zh: 编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍；硬件使单 GPU 规模研究民主化。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty reasons; near-term risks like hacking outweigh existential AI risk.
kaiser.zh: 开源模型因主权原因持续存在；近期风险（如黑客攻击）比 AI 存在风险更紧迫。

reinerpope.en: Initially focused on inference economics: batch size and memory bandwidth dominate cost, not compute.
reinerpope.zh: 最初关注推理经济学：批量大小和内存带宽主导成本，而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Argued models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost, a contrarian view.
reinerpope.zh: 提出由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，这是反共识观点。

reinerpope.en: Shifted to hardware fundamentals: multiply-accumulate and systolic arrays as core primitives.
reinerpope.zh: 转向硬件基础：乘累加和脉动阵列作为核心原语。

reinerpope.en: Emphasized data movement dominates compute even inside chips, reinforcing memory-centric view.
reinerpope.zh: 强调数据移动在芯片内部也主导算力，强化了以内存为中心的观点。

reinerpope.en: Consistent theme: memory bandwidth and data movement are key bottlenecks across inference and hardware.
reinerpope.zh: 一贯主题：内存带宽和数据移动是推理和硬件中的关键瓶颈。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla; data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute. Open source safer via scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正；数据质量与效率同算力同等重要。开源因可审查而更安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains 100x in three years; value shifts to applications, not just foundation models. Enterprise adoption underestimated long-term.
mensch.zh: 2024 年：三年内效率提升百倍；价值转向应用层，而非仅基础模型。企业采用长期被低估。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure. AI augments jobs, not replaces. Decentralized open-source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年：主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施。AI 增强而非取代工作。去中心化开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via vertical specialization and customization. Pre-training saturation; domain fine-tuning key. AGI never a single system.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：模型商品化；差异化靠垂直专业化与定制。预训练饱和，领域微调关键。AGI 非单一系统。

mensch.en: Europe two-year window for AI infrastructure. Enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not intelligence. AGI is a direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：欧洲两年窗口期建设 AI 基础设施。企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非智能。AGI 是方向而非终点。

felixrieseberg.en: Initially emphasized local compute and shared tools, but later shifted focus to broader AI adoption and human-centric design.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最初强调本地算力和共享工具，但后来转向更广泛的 AI 应用和以人为本的设计。

felixrieseberg.en: Evolved from technical scaffolding to user empowerment, stressing that AI should handle tedious tasks and that anyone can leverage AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 从技术脚手架演变为用户赋能，强调 AI 应处理繁琐任务，任何人都可以利用 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Consistently championed AI as a tool for augmenting human creativity and productivity, not replacing human judgment.
felixrieseberg.zh: 始终倡导 AI 作为增强人类创造力和生产力的工具，而非取代人类判断。

felixrieseberg.en: Shifted from caution about AI's impact on junior employees to optimism about AI-native learning and rapid skill acquisition.
felixrieseberg.zh: 从对 AI 影响初级员工的谨慎态度，转变为对 AI 原生学习和快速技能获取的乐观态度。

felixrieseberg.en: Emphasized asynchronous interaction and debugging workflows with AI, moving beyond direct supervision to outcome-based evaluation.
felixrieseberg.zh: 强调与 AI 的异步交互和调试工作流，超越直接监督，转向基于结果的评估。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是智能体无人工干预持续运行的经济可行性。

danshipper.en: Everyone will delegate to agents; agents need human oversight; SaaS thrives as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人都将拥有至少一个智能体，但智能体需要人类监督；SaaS 并未消亡，反而因智能体增加用户而受益。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work are future work surfaces; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，命令行界面过时，图形界面如 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 成为未来工作界面；公司应拥有一个超级智能体而非个人智能体。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents and create new value; AI writing often better for internal docs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，AI 失业末日论是谎言；人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值；AI 生成的内部文档写作往往更优。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real tasks need human framing; AI edge is where AI meets humans.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，基准测试高估了 AI 自主性；现实任务需要人类设定框架；AI 的边界在于 AI 与人类真实接触之处。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant due to industry investment; openness prevents corporate capture; safety is system-level.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 因行业投入仍为主流；开放性防止企业垄断；安全是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance; RLVR enables reasoning and tool use.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能；RLVR 解锁推理与工具使用。

lambert.en: Hybrid reasoning models may be temporary; inference-time scaling plots are misleading; open models win on character.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：混合推理模型或为过渡；推理时缩放曲线具误导性；开放模型在个性与品格上胜出。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling persists but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：预训练缩放定律仍成立但易得收益已尽；增长转向后训练与推理时缩放。

lambert.en: Open models drive next decade of research; Chinese labs excel in engineering; US-China gap may widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开放模型驱动未来十年研究；中国实验室精于工程；美中差距或扩大。

dylanfield.en: Design is key differentiator; AI merges roles, everyone becomes product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Design becomes new code; visual-first design enables pull requests to production; direct manipulation beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 设计成为新代码；视觉优先的设计实现生产级拉取请求；直接操作优于提示。

dylanfield.en: AI integration is at very start; human judgment in divergence-convergence loops is key for creativity.
dylanfield.zh: AI 整合尚处于起步阶段；人类在发散-收敛循环中的判断力是创造力的关键。

karpathy.en: Scaling up language models with next-token prediction on internet data leads to emergent properties like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为通过互联网数据上的下一个词预测来扩展语言模型，会产生涌现特性，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future, but maintaining entropy is critical to avoid silent model collapse.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来，但保持熵至关重要，以避免无声的模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: This will be the decade of agents, not the year; they need a decade to overcome cognitive deficits like continual learning and multimodality.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我认为这是智能体的十年，而非一年；它们需要十年时间克服持续学习和多模态等认知缺陷。

karpathy.en: Since December, I haven't typed a line of code; I delegate everything to agents. The bottleneck is now skill in directing them.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，自去年 12 月起，我没再写过一行代码，一切交给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥它们的技能。

karpathy.en: You can outsource your thinking, but you can't outsource your understanding—that remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解——这仍是人类的瓶颈。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建和交付，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists, not just T-shaped; hire cracked new grads over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才，而非仅 T 型人才；优先招聘有潜力的新毕业生而非资深员工。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped, deep T specialist, and cracked new grad; taste alone insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和潜力新毕业生；仅凭品味不够。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools; focus on work and users, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；采用新工具前等待 6 个月；聚焦工作和用户，而非炒作。

jennywen.en: Speed is key; ship early, iterate fast; but speed alone is not improvement; judgment and vision matter.
jennywen.zh: 速度是关键；尽早发布、快速迭代；但速度本身不是改进；判断力和愿景更重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and careful governance are essential.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署和谨慎治理至关重要（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心目标；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天（2026）。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中（2026）。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural networks outperform hand-coded stacks; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 端到端神经网络优于手工编码栈；混合系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处试探性前行。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了驾驶模型的表示、推理和个性化。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning; scaling via data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题，最好用端到端学习解决；通过数据、算力和世界模型进行扩展。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 对于深度学习，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in short and medium term; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities possible.
kendall.zh: 短期内消费级车辆将超过机器人出租车；在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化是可能的。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo mislead; deep human evaluation is the gold standard for measuring progress.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；深度人工评估是衡量进展的黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟真实世界任务。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 多样化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is critical; AI tools can cause anchoring and sycophancy, so safety and omission risks matter.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断至关重要；AI 工具可能导致锚定和谄媚，因此安全性和遗漏风险需重视。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn from real users.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以从真实用户中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，界面将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, accelerated for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型产品化。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响（2024）。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现（2024）。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据（2026）。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 如今，结合强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键（2026）。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 可解释性虽重要，但对于 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需（始终）。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI adoption.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 安全和负责任部署是最大挑战，非洲可在 AI 应用上跨越遗留问题。

nando.en: AI should be a tool for all humanity, extending capabilities and solving global problems.
nando.zh: 始终认为 AI 应作为全人类的工具，扩展能力并解决全球性问题。

nando.en: From focusing on technical paths (video learning, generalist agents) to emphasizing societal challenges and safety.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注技术路径（视频学习、通用智能体）转向 2026 年强调社会挑战和安全。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding; research requires embracing failure.
nando.zh: 2026 年，认为沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要，研究需要拥抱失败。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. We should not align AI to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，控制 AI 是危险的，不应将 AI 对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能的核心，下一个词预测不是实质目标，LLM 缺乏世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习，如 Oak 架构。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; current LLMs don't learn from experience after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习是试错学习，而当前 LLM 部署后不学习，RLHF 并非真正的经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他提出学习利于学习的表示是首要未解问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一关键问题。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能；微调可能过时。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new architectures.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，预训练加强化学习或许足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the real bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator and will accelerate AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性才是瓶颈，编程是 AI 进步的领先指标，将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30 hours) expands capabilities; training pipelines are primitive.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习是新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）大幅扩展能力，现有训练流程还很原始。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; future work involves managing agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要，未来工作将是管理智能体团队。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能媲美较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我始终强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我提出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning, even during pre-training, can improve reasoning and yield lasting gains.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我转向强调强化学习（包括预训练阶段）能提升推理能力并带来持久收益。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can be powerful.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性，并认为用多样化的合成数据训练的小模型可以很强大。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; consumer products must be fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加快交付；消费产品必须快速、熟悉且无需学习。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms for expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 初创公司的品牌策略应优先考虑招聘和差异化；品牌指南是表达力的动态平台。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs requires clear decision-making and empowering designers; don't innovate on interaction design, use familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切代价追求速度需要清晰的决策和赋能设计师；不要在交互设计上创新，使用熟悉的模式。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win; brand narrative attracts top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计如何帮助公司获胜；品牌叙事吸引顶尖人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; avoid structured crits; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘多样技能和原型，而非克隆；避免结构化评审；在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI is a creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码作为设计工具的最终真相源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should emphasize craft and intentionality over process; side projects and paid tests signal skill better.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，作品集应重工艺与意图而非流程；副项目和付费测试更能体现能力。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary programming interface; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要的编程方式；示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放，成为下一个主要 AI 进步驱动力。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是在速度和成本方面。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 的变革将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers, startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导，初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents need root-cause analysis for productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，未来编程语言优先考虑可验证性以适应 AI 生成；编码智能体需根因分析提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business results.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents compared to agents, not humans; incumbents fail to transition; consumer agents disrupt SEO and ads.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，AI 智能体与智能体而非人类比较；现有企业转型失败；消费智能体颠覆 SEO 和广告。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，认为通过更多算力和数据扩展模型能带来更智能的 AI，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models improve via algorithmic advances and hardware scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇；模型进步来自算法和硬件扩展。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling and specialization.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口；模块化稀疏架构实现高效扩展和专业化。

shazeer.en: AI safety requires engineering safeguards and human oversight; understanding model capabilities is crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，AI 安全需要工程防护和人类监督；理解模型能力至关重要。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are key.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，测试时算力扩展推动进步但不足以实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习是关键。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from writing code to architecture and oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 会因杰文斯悖论增加而非减少程序员数量；工程师角色从写代码转向架构与监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; freezing models would still yield a decade of product innovation; all stack layers will benefit.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突发的；即使冻结模型，产品创新仍有十年空间；AI 堆栈各层都将受益。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI agents require trust and permissions, not full autonomy; future coding involves both synchronous and asynchronous agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他指出企业级 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；未来编程包含同步与异步智能体协作。

scottwu.en: Product interface design for human-agent collaboration is the biggest challenge, not model capabilities; stickiness beats moats.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月至 8 月，他持续认为人机协作的产品界面设计是最大挑战，而非模型能力；粘性胜过护城河。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will grow as AI empowers more builders; basics like hiring and execution remain key differentiators.
scottwu.zh: 始终，他坚信 AI 赋能更多创造者，软件工程需求将增长；招聘与执行等基本功仍是关键差异化因素。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发。应注重技能培养，而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我认为 RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. Need third-party testing and regulation.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我认为 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足。需要第三方测试和监管。
